init.title: Apple TV Siri Voice
init.description:
**Routing.** With no entity set, every utterance goes to Siri. Set one and only utterances made while it is in one of the listed states go to Siri; the rest go to the fallbacks below. The usual rule is the Apple TV itself: `media_player.apple_tv` while `on, idle, playing, paused`.

**Assist satellites.** Make a pipeline whose speech-to-text is an Apple TV's **Siri** entity and whose conversation agent is **Siri (silent)**. The silent agent exists only so the pipeline does not say *"Sorry, I didn't understand"* over Siri's reply — it answers Siri's utterances with silence and passes anything else to the fallback agent.

data.siri_when_entity: Send to Siri while this entity…

data_description.siri_when_entity: Leave blank to send everything to Siri.
data_description.siri_when_states: Comma separated. `idle` is the Apple TV awake on its home screen.
data_description.fallback_stt: A real speech-to-text engine, for Assist-satellite utterances that are not for Siri.
data_description.fallback_agent: The agent that answers those. Not *Siri (silent)*.
data_description.tts_engine: Pin it — Home Assistant's default is the Cloud engine, which fails when signed out.
